name: TradeChannel
summary: A price channel breakout EA that identifies support and resistance levels using a Donchian-style channel, then opens buy/sell positions when price breaks through these levels. It includes ATR-based stop loss, a martingale-like lot reduction after consecutive losses, and a simple trailing stop mechanism.
summary_zh: 基于价格通道突破的EA，利用唐奇安风格通道识别支撑和阻力位，当价格突破这些水平时开仓做多或做空。包含基于ATR的止损、连续亏损后缩减仓位的类马丁格尔资金管理以及简单的移动止损机制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用价格通道（Donchian Channel）来识别支撑和阻力位，通道周期由rChannel参数控制。入场条件分为两种：一是价格突破通道边界（高点触及阻力位开多，低点触及支撑位开空），且当前阻力/支撑与前一日相同表示通道稳定；二是收盘价在通道内但偏向中枢方向时也可触发入场。出场条件同样基于通道突破信号，当持有多头时高点触及阻力位则平仓，持有空头时低点触及支撑位则平仓。仓位管理采用两种模式：固定手数或基于最大风险比例动态计算手数，并通过DcF参数在连续亏损后缩减仓位。止损基于ATR指标计算，多头止损为支撑位减去ATR值，空头止损为阻力位加上ATR值加买卖价差。移动止损功能在盈利达到Trailing点数后将止损跟进至保本位或更优位置。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses a Donchian-style price channel with a configurable period (rChannel) to identify support and resistance levels. Entry signals come in two forms: first, when price breaks the channel boundary (high touching resistance for buy, low touching support for sell) with the current channel level matching the previous period's level, indicating channel stability; second, when the close price is inside the channel butbiases toward the pivot direction. Exit conditions mirror the breakout signals: closing longs when the high touches resistance, and closing shorts when the low touches support. Position sizing offers two modes: fixed lots or dynamic calculation based on a maximum risk percentage of free margin, with a DcF parameter that reduces lot size after consecutive losses. Stop loss is ATR-based: for buys it's support minus ATR, for sells it's resistance plus ATR plus the spread. The trailing stop feature moves the stop loss to breakeven or better once profit exceeds the Trailing parameter in points.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 下单手数，为0时使用MaxR风险比例计算
parameters.description_en: Order lot size; 0 uses MaxR for dynamic calculation

parameters.name: SndMl
parameters.description: 开仓和平仓时是否发送邮件通知
parameters.description_en: Send email notification on open and close

parameters.name: DcF
parameters.description: 亏损时手数缩减因子，值越小缩减越大，为0则不缩减
parameters.description_en: Lot decrease factor on loss; smaller = larger decrease, 0 = disabled

parameters.name: MaxR
parameters.description: 最大风险比例(0-1)，占可用资金的份额，Lots为0时使用
parameters.description_en: Max risk ratio (0-1) of available funds, used when Lots is 0

parameters.name: pATR
parameters.description: ATR指标周期，用于计算止损距离
parameters.description_en: ATR indicator period for stop loss distance calculation

parameters.name: rChannel
parameters.description: 价格通道周期，用于计算支撑和阻力
parameters.description_en: Price channel period for support and resistance calculation

parameters.name: Trailing
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，为0则关闭移动止损
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points; 0 disables trailing stop

pros: 使用ATR动态计算止损，能够根据市场波动性自适应调整止损距离
具有止损保护机制和移动止损功能，有利于锁定盈利
包含连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，有助于控制回撤风险
通道突破策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和参数调优
开仓前检查止损距离是否满足经纪商最小止损水平要求
pros_en: ATR-based dynamic stop loss adapts to market volatility automatically
Includes stop loss protection and trailing stop functionality to lock in profits
Lot reduction mechanism after consecutive losses helps control drawdown risk
Channel breakout strategy logic is clear, easy to understand and tune parameters
Checks minimum stop level requirements before opening positions
cons: isCloseBuy和isOpenBuy的信号逻辑完全相同，导致刚开的多头仓位可能在下一根K线立即被平仓
通道突破的入场和出场信号对称但缺乏差异化，没有止盈目标仅依赖止损和反向信号出场
DcF仓位缩减机制在连续亏损时减少手数而非增加，虽保守但可能错过回本机会
defPcChannel函数中CopyLow的返回值检查有bug（==1而非==-1），可能导致数据获取失败未被发现
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在流动性差或点差大的时段可能产生不利成交
cons_en: isCloseBuy and isOpenBuy share identical signal logic, causing a newly opened long position to potentially close on the very next bar
Symmetric entry/exit signals lack differentiation; no take-profit target, relying solely on stop loss and reversal signals for exits
The DcF lot reduction mechanism decreases size after losses rather than increasing, which is conservative but may miss recovery opportunities
Bug in defPcChannel: CopyLow return value check uses ==1 instead of ==-1, potentially missing data fetch failures
Missing spread filter and trading session filter, may result in unfavorable fills during low liquidity or high spread periods
improvements: 区分入场和出场信号逻辑，例如使用不同的通道周期或增加确认条件避免刚开仓即平仓
修复defPcChannel中CopyLow返回值检查的bug（应改为==-1），并增加止盈目标和点差过滤
增加交易时段过滤和点差检查，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Differentiate entry and exit signal logic, e.g., use different channel periods or add confirmation conditions to avoid immediate close after open
Fix the CopyLow return value check bug in defPcChannel (change ==1 to ==-1), and add take-profit targets and spread filter
Add trading session filter and spread check to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 入场和出场信号相同可能导致频繁开平仓造成手续费损失
defPcChannel函数中CopyLow返回值检查bug可能导致使用未初始化数据
没有止盈目标，盈利完全依赖移动止损或反向信号出场，可能在震荡市中被反复止损
连续亏损后手数缩减虽降低风险但也降低了回本能力
risk_points_en: Identical entry and exit signals may cause frequent open-close cycles leading to commission losses
CopyLow return value check bug in defPcChannel may cause use of uninitialized data
No take-profit target means profits rely entirely on trailing stop or reversal signals, risking repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
Lot reduction after consecutive losses reduces risk but also diminishes recovery capacity
